product.description: A member opens the app, creates a daily habit, and checks in each day.

response.justification: Next.js gives you a single well-trodden framework for the screens and the server bits, which is exactly what a habit tracker on the web needs.

alternatives.name: SvelteKit
alternatives.tradeoff: Lighter to write, fewer hired hands know it.

response.justification: A rock-solid relational database that fits the Habit and CheckIn tables cleanly and scales well past your first hundreds of users.

alternatives.name: SQLite
alternatives.tradeoff: Zero setup, awkward once you have many writers.

alternatives.name: MySQL
alternatives.tradeoff: Also solid, slightly weaker JSON support.

response.justification: Because people upload files, you need somewhere durable to keep them; S3 is the default the whole ecosystem is built around.

alternatives.name: Supabase Storage
alternatives.tradeoff: Bundled with the DB, less control.

response.justification: A hosted sign-in service so you do not hand-roll password security; drops into a Next.js app in an afternoon.

alternatives.name: Auth.js
alternatives.tradeoff: Free and flexible, more wiring to do.

alternatives.name: Supabase Auth
alternatives.tradeoff: Bundled with the DB, less polished UI.
